name: my-workflow
description: A spec-driven software workflow for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot. drive-spec decides the kind of task (feature, bug or improvement), creates specs/<task>/workflow.yaml as the spec's metadata and progress, maps your installed stack skills to each step, and runs that kind's steps through the spec-* skills: spec-requirements (user stories with acceptance criteria) or spec-diagnose (root cause before any fix), spec-design (module, component or system level), spec-plan (tasks.md, batches, delegation), spec-implement and spec-review (tests, validation, code review). Steps save their artifacts (spec.md, design.md, tasks.md, review.md) from templates and also work alone without a spec. The spec-architect, spec-tester, spec-implementer and spec-reviewer agents join when they pay off. Standalone skills: rephrase, discuss, audit-truth, scaffold-project-structure, design-component, analyze-ui-state. code-auditor builds a codebase atlas.
